Full-frame vertical composition, no letterboxing or black bars, and keep the complete glasses visible in hero shots. Charcoal studio background with subtle warm ivory accents. Soft key light with a narrow rim light and controlled lens reflections. Restrained camera movement and clean cuts. From 0 to 2 seconds, a three-quarter hero view with a soft lighting reveal. From 2 to 4 seconds, a close detail of the lenses and frame with a controlled moving reflection. From 4 to 6 seconds, a slight side angle showing the arm with a gentle camera glide. From 6 to 8 seconds, a full product hero view with a steady final frame. No humans, no text, no logos, no added accessories, no changes to product geometry or colour. Light instrumental electronic beat at low volume, no vocals, with subtle ambient studio audio.
